command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is right that the source line is not safe as a single literal command; however, the raw read is automatable once its standard fields and target reservation contract are packaged.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use raw 0x04/0x20 for bounds, optional approved 0x04/0x22 reservation, then raw 0x04/0x21 with validated reservation ID, record ID, offset and small read length; follow only verified returned next-record semantics.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Master command family, OOB path and 10/5 timing remain preserved; placeholder zeros and 0xFF are recorded as source defects, not silently executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Perform a finite reservation-aware iterator, validate every completion and response length, reassemble each declared record length, decode supported types and preserve unsupported bytes without guessing.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns one unsafe placeholder request into the bounded read sequence needed by the title while leaving Master unchanged.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This proves readable device-SDR contents, not Add/Delete/Clear behavior or correctness of every sensor reading.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Reservation loss, corrupt next-record IDs or unsupported record types may leave an intentionally incomplete inventory boundary.

project_override_considerations: A vendor inventory API is equivalent only if it exposes record identity, complete raw content and termination semantics; otherwise the raw 0x04/0x21 path remains unverified.
expected_evidence: Every redacted request/response with record ID, offset and length

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently targets Get Device SDR through raw 0x04/0x21. Its zero placeholders, 0xFF request length, missing iterator semantics, and success-only criterion make the procedure incomplete and unsafe to execute literally, but no two source statements require incompatible behavior; the review supplies bounded read semantics without treating the gaps as a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read purpose and command are identifiable; target contract, parser and inventory expectations are execution prerequisites rather than permanent semantic blockers.

review_improvement: Prevents oversized or cyclic reads, ties each chunk to one verified record, and makes an incomplete enumeration boundary visible instead of guessing past it.
independent_technical_reasoning: Device-SDR retrieval is an iterator, not a one-shot fetch: the client must manage reservation scope when required, record identity, offsets, declared length, returned next ID and a finite termination rule. A 0xFF request and command-success criterion can hide truncation or loops. Complete raw reconstruction plus schema-aware decoding is the minimum evidence for the title.
